threats.threat: Oracle poisoning or unauthorized expectation mutation
mitigationsVerified: All governed inputs are pinned to exact SHA-256 values before artifact construction.
The changed identity set exactly equals the 145 identities in sealed C37 adjudication.
Every revised value equals the corresponding sealed C37 actual.reason value.
All 3,720 rows were independently compared and no field other than expectedReasonCodeFamily changed on the 145 authorized rows.
threats.residualRisk: R4 intentionally incorporates sealed development analyzer output and therefore must remain development governance evidence, not independent, unseen, blind, or holdout evidence.

mitigationsVerified: The runner contains no hard-coded oracle IDs, row IDs, fixture IDs, queries, expected reason values, or test IDs.
Target identities and replacement values are derived only from the complete hash-locked C37 adjudication input.
No production implementation imports or runtime candidates are present.
threats.residualRisk: The revision is not suitable as independent generalization evidence because its purpose is governed development-oracle reconciliation.

threats.threat: Live analyzer contamination or runtime feedback during R4 construction
mitigationsVerified: Runner imports are limited to node:crypto, node:fs, node:path, and node:child_process.
The only child process is fixed-argument read-only Git inspection.
No analyzer, production boundary, network client, fetch call, model, or live runtime is imported or executed.
threats.residualRisk: Sealed C37 analyzer output is an explicit input and is truthfully identified as such.

threats.threat: Path traversal, arbitrary overwrite, partial publication, or unauthorized staging
mitigationsVerified: All output paths are fixed repository-relative constants and receive lexical repository-containment checks.
R4 directory creation requires absence and uses recursive:false; file creation uses exclusive wx mode.
Branch, HEAD, staged state, input hashes, and output path collisions are checked before the first write.
A post-build rerun failed closed on the existing R4 directory before writes and left the R4 hash unchanged.
The runner has no add, commit, push, reset, checkout, clean, stash, merge, rebase, deployment, migration, reindex, provider, or network action.
threats.residualRisk: A technical failure after the first write can leave append-only partial artifacts; the runner labels that state TECHNICAL_FAILURE_AFTER_WRITE and collision checks prevent silent overwrite. Recovery must remain separately governed.

mitigationsVerified: No environment variables, credentials, authentication material, request headers, or user records are read or logged.
A high-confidence credential-pattern scan across the runner, result, and 12 R4 artifacts found zero matches.
Error output is limited to governed paths, hashes, invariant failures, and fixed Git inspection failures.

items.title: Partial append-only output requires governed recovery after a mid-write technical failure
items.evidence: The runner writes 12 files and then the result sequentially. It uses exclusive creation and explicitly reports TECHNICAL_FAILURE_AFTER_WRITE, but it does not transactionally roll back a partial directory.
items.disposition: Accept for this one-shot append-only governed builder; do not publish or recover a partial run outside separate governance. Current output set is complete, exactly 12 files, JSON-parseable, and hash-consistent.

items.title: R4 is analyzer-informed development evidence
items.evidence: R4 revisions intentionally use sealed C37 actual.reason values. The generated oracle, freeze, supersession record, adjudication, and contamination audit consistently mark the evidence non-independent, non-holdout, non-unseen, and non-blind.
items.disposition: R4 may support C38 development-oracle governance only; it must not be represented as independent Phase-10A closure evidence.

items.title: Independent external Phase-10A review remains unsatisfied
items.disposition: C38 requires internal Reviewer approval only. Do not infer Phase-10A closure from this C38 security pass.
